title: An `id` of `.` reaching a sibling's `mask.png`
why: `.` is the one that reads as harmless: no separator, every character in the class, and not the `..` everyone checks for — yet `known-differences/./` normalises to the root itself, so a `mask` of `some-other-id/mask.png` is genuinely contained and the containment check passes. One acceptance can then address every sibling's artifacts.
